newsitem.title: BARBADOS: U.S. stands ready to help Iranian quake victims.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stands ready to help Iranian quake victims.

text.p: The United States stands ready to help provide relief assistance to Iranian quake victims, White House officials said on Sunday.

White House spokeswoman Mary Ellen Glynn, travelling with President Bill Clinton to this Caribbean island, said the United States in the past had typically provided assistance through international relief organisations like the Red Cross and the Red Crescent and was willing to do so again.
"We stand ready to provide anything they need," she said.
Up to 2,400 people were killed and 40,000 injured on Saturday when a major earthquake devastated some 200 villages in a rural area in eastern Iran, state media in Iran said.
The quake struck with a force of 7.1 on the Richter scale. It was Iran's most severe earthquake since 1990 when a quake killed more than 35,000 people.
